messages:
elen-csm: Quick flag  we discovered an embeddings ingestion slowdown that affected ~92 onboarding tenants overnight, ~16 in a <45d renewal window. Proposing a 'Renewal Shield' outreach: small credit, 30m remediation slot, short attestation for regulated customers, and a one-click diagnostic link in the email. Thoughts?

omar-cs: I like the name Renewal Shield. For regulated customers (HIPAA/GDPR) add an explicit data-integrity attestation line: 'No PII/PHI was modified; vectors requeued but unchanged.' Legal needs to review wording.

jia-eng: Root cause: transient congestion in background replay workers after a hot deploy. No vectors deleted, but some indexing jobs delayed and reordered. We pushed a fix; queue replay is throttled. Recommend advising customers not to re-run bulk reindexes.

marta-ops: Ops can run APAC-friendly and EMEA-friendly remediation slots next week. I'll create a special calendar feed with pre-filled tenant ID param: https://cal.redwood.ai/renewal-shield (will include timezone detection).

ben-fin: Finance prelim ok on credits. Suggest formula: credit = min( (downtime_minutes / 60) * monthly_avg_usage * 0.02, $1000 ) — small and tied to usage. CS to propose per-account amounts and I can sign-off.

elen-csm (draft email): ```Subject: Renewal Shield: short remediation + goodwill credit after onboarding delay

Hi <Customer>,
Overnight we experienced an onboarding ingestion slowdown that may have delayed embedding indexing for a subset of tenants. Engineers mitigated the root cause and we have not detected data loss.

No action required if search results behave normally. If you see missing or inconsistent results, choose one of the options below:
- One-click diagnostic (runs automated vector-count check) -> <diagnostic_link>
- Schedule a 30-minute remediation slot: https://cal.redwood.ai/renewal-shield
- Request a proactive 1:1 (we'll reach out if your renewal <45d)

For customers with compliance needs, we can provide a short attestation confirming no data modification occurred during replay.

We are also offering a small, usage-proportional goodwill credit under our "Renewal Shield" program. If you'd like us to evaluate an account-specific credit, reply to this email or pick a slot and we'll handle it directly.

Thanks for your patience — we want to make this right.
Best,
Elen on behalf of Customer Success
```

jia-eng: Suggest adding a tiny diagnostic snippet for advanced users (Console or curl):
```bash
# quick vector-count check
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/<index>/stats | jq '.vector_count'
```
Include both one-click and CLI options.

omar-cs: Legal will review attestation copy. Also recommend a 20-30s localized video (EN/ES) summarizing next steps for customers who prefer that.

marta-ops: I'll add an email footer link to a short RCA appendix once it's cleared for external publication. Also configuring the auto-ticket rule: any customer who clicks diagnostic or schedules a 1:1 opens INC-RENEWAL-3490 and tags account owner.

sys-bot: Ticket INC-RENEWAL-3490 created and will be assigned to CS on user action.

ben-fin: Action items: 1) elen finalize email + diagnostic link by 18:00 PT; 2) jia publish CLI snippet and sign-off diagnostics; 3) marta create calendar + ticket automation; 4) omar route legal attestation copy to Legal. I'll approve credit amounts for top 16 renewal-risk accounts once CS proposes numbers.

elen-csm: Timeline sounds good. Target: first wave to <45d cohort tomorrow 08:00 local time. We'll run 30m remediation slots and capture a 2-question survey after each session: (1) resolved? yes/no (2) any remaining asks? free text.

jia-eng: I'll verify the diagnostic endpoint and confirm by 22:00 PT.

omar-cs: I'll start legal thread now.

marta-ops: Calendar + ticket automation will be live by EOD.

elen-csm: Thanks team  let's aim to protect renewal momentum and capture quick feedback. Closing -> will post post-wave notes and credit proposals in follow-up.
